messages:
jamie: saw a small billing spike from yesterday's canary, digging in
sofia: where in the stack? console, ledger, or router?
jamie: ledger shows two charges for what looks like the same user stream: a small prefix charge then a full completion charge after a retry
mike: do we have the raw stream logs? could be client retried and rotated the toolcall id
jamie: yes, logs attached in the repro. tl;dr: client got a premature EOF, retried, SDK generated a fresh toolcall id so ledger treated prefix and retry as separate toolcalls
ali: was this made worse by the model swap? we bumped some canary traffic to quant_v2 during the window
jamie: exactly. prefix tokens were attributed to variant A, retry completed on variant B, so invoices show both
sofia: this is nasty because reconciliation can't easily merge across variants once ledger entries are stamped
mike: quick temporary mitigation: mark prefix credits provisional until stream completes or TTLs expire. then only finalize once we see completion or gap
ali: can we also add a route-handoff flag so accounting rows include which route/variant was active? ops wants to filter those in alerting
ops: yes please. muted "canary-billing" pager for 24h while we triage :+1:
eng-bot: deploy-bot adjusted canary fraction -> 20% (rolled by @deploy-bot)
jamie: proposed short-term plan:
- ledger: make prefix credits provisional and attach session+offset metadata
- retry handling: if incoming session id matches and offsets overlap, dedupe credits to the earliest matching toolcall id
- console: show provisional credits in timeline and allow filtering by "handoff" tag
mike: long-term: introduce a session-canonical toolcall id that survives SDK retries. SDKs can opt-in; server can derive fallback using session+first-offset
sofia: agree. also add a dashboard panel that shows per-session token flow (prefix vs resumed vs final) and model-variant attribution
ali: low-risk change: surface a "route-handoff" boolean on billing rows and an explanatory note in invoice UI for canary windows
jamie: created a small repro script: /eng-platform/tests/repro_stream_retry_rotate.sh and put logs in internal storage
mike: i'll prototype the ledger dedupe logic. plan to flag provisional credits and run a nightly reconcile job to collapse dupes
sofia: i'll mock the console timeline and add filters. will include an annotation in the billing timeline when provisional credits are resolved
ali: ops: please keep suppressing noisy billing alerts for canary while we test. also let finance know there may be transient duplicates in the CSV export
ops: done. alerted finance and paused the canary-billing alert rule
jamie: RFC incoming in ~90m. aiming for a small ledger patch today to tag provisional charges, follow-up dedupe next week
mike: ping me on the RFC, i'll push a spike branch for the ledger change
sofia: dashboard link draft: https://redwood.internal/d/streams/stream-token-flow?org=redwood — feedback welcome
jamie: thanks team. next check-in after RFC review. and thx for the quick ops mute :pray:
